title: File access built from input (rust) — review required
description: A rust file operation builds its path from input: File::opens*(s*format!. Traversal sequences escape the directory. This lexical rule flags the construction; the reviewer confirms confinement via canonicalize plus prefix check.
remediation: Confine with canonicalize plus prefix check or map input through an allowlist.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any input-built path matches.
